name: Lu Xun
title: The Pillar of Heaven

skills.name: Humility
skills.text: When you become the target of STEAL 顺手牵羊 or ACEDIA 乐不思蜀, these cards are nullified.

skills.name: Scrutinize
skills.text: During your action phase, you can use a red on-hand card as AMASS 以逸待勞.

differenceFromNormal: The ability description for "Humility" has been changed from “cannot become the target of... ” to “... cards are nullified”. “One after another”, his signature ability, has been replaced by “Scrutinize”, which turns Lu Xun from a highly independent character to a support character.
